description:
Emergency numbers for one country: data.numbers.value {police, ambulance, fire, general, all_numbers}. A role without its own number is null: then use general, else all_numbers (in 58 countries only all_numbers is filled). Use it when only these numbers are needed; get_country_facts for several facts, get_trip_brief for a whole trip. No data for the country is a not-found error. Each fact is cited: sources[] (url, license), last_verified, confidence.
Parameters: country is where the call will be made (the traveller's location, not home); alpha-2 works best. Example: {"country":"JP"}.
Read-only; keyless (free key or x402 lifts limits: https://citedtravel.com/pricing/); errors RFC 9457.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

lang.description: Language for localized names (BCP 47). Supported: en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; aliases such as zh, zh-CN, zh-TW and zh-HK are mapped, and anything else falls back to English. Only names are localized; verbatim official quotes stay in their original language.
